notes: Boot elvis (5.00) with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0, built-in mechanisms off. Walk the Portals service menu with the Black ENTER (public 0) and Green RIGHT (public -1) buttons: Portals, MAIN MENU (DIAG), DIAGNOSTICS MENU (SW), SWITCH TEST MENU (TEST), two steps right to DED, and enter the Dedicated Switch Test, which prints the name and wiring the ROM holds for each closed dedicated switch. Hold and release, one at a time, the flipper-column inputs 84, 83, 82, 81 and 88.
